name: Beat jump navigation
lesson:
## Jump the right distance

B's BEAT JUMP pads 1 to 4 set to 4, 8, 16 and 32 beats. Three situations: B is 8 beats behind, so jump 8 within the first bar; B has a 32-beat beatless intro you want to skip, so jump 32 at bar 9; B is 4 beats out, so jump 4 at bar 13.

Beat jump moves the playhead by an exact number of beats while keeping it on the grid, so the phrase realigns instantly instead of over a nudge. The choice is the score: jumping 16 when the answer was 8 puts you on the wrong bar of the right phrase. Decide from the count, then press once.
